notes.title: Super Magbot Patch v1.02
notes.content:
This patch fixes some bugs mainly for the speedrun community and adds some minor features.

[list]
[*] Added -skipintro executable parameter to skip the logos/intro when starting the game.
[*] Added option in the Options/Graphics menu to enable/disable VSYNC.
[*] Fixed timestep simulation in all player movement actions. (Fixes the Dash bending bug on high fps PCs)
[*] Now you can't pause when the player character is playing Birth/Death animations. This prevents the pause softlock bug.
[*] Now all the core game actors are updated with a fixed timestep.
[*] Added Discord community button in the main menu. (Only PC version)
[*] Fixed Bubble Magnets not removing Queue Animators Actors causing bad performance.
[*] Teleport magnets travel sound stops when going back to the main menu from pause.
[*] 4-9 missing background tile fixed.
[*] 4-18 fixed connection ids for the connected swapping magnets of this level.
[*] 4-21 Camera Limits fixed. Now the camera will not move in this level.
[*] 2-16 Fixed wrong background tiles.
[*] Fixed camera reposition bug in Boss 3 (Octofok)
[/list]

notes.title: Illuminate your Super Magbot experience with Corsair iCUE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, magnet masters of the future![/h3]

Super Magbot is partnering with Corsair to bring iCUE lighting support to the platformer where you cannot jump! That's right, you'll have the opportunity to fully immerse yourselves in the Megnetia star system, encompassing four unique worlds — which Magbot must traverse and complete on your journey to becoming Super Magbot! Master the power of magnets with an authentic light show for your Corsair devices.

[i]Check it out! How cool![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sGAvNOm.gif[/img]

[h3]What is iCUE?[/h3]

iCUE lets you fully synchronize the RGB lighting on all your compatible CORSAIR devices for a setup-wide light show beyond compare. Monitor real-time temperatures, set custom lighting effects to inform you if your temps start running high, and create automated fan curves to adjust fan speeds. Adjust your system’s performance based on your activity – make a quiet mode for focusing on work, a max performance mode for gaming at high settings, or anything in-between.

CORSAIR iCUE game integrations allow developers to bring games to life like never before. Turn a player’s desktop setup into a fully synchronized, real-time visualization of in-game actions and events through CORSAIR’s extensive iCUE‑enabled product lines. Set the mood, immerse the player, and create the most complete gaming experience possible.

Visit Corsair [url=https://www.corsair.com/eu/en/Categories/Products/CORSAIR-iCUE/c/Cor_Products_iCue_Compatibility][HERE][/url] for more information to get you started!

[h3]Tell me more about Super Magbot
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37459635/c779edb420514d3c4e28a4ace531a9a3ff2ec9aa.png[/img]

Sure! The system of Magnetia is in great peril as an evil villain tears through the galaxy. It’s all down to one robot explorer to save the day – Magbot!

Armed with the power to control both positive and negative magnetic polarities, Magbot must navigate through a myriad of challenging platforming environments to save his home planet of Mag Tek.

[list]
[*] Use Magnetic Force to Attract: Use the power of magnetic attraction to pull yourself towards platforms and across perilous pitfalls.
[*] Use Magnetic Force to Repel: Magbots are very heavy and can’t jump! Use to power of magnetic repulsion to boost yourself through the air!
[*] Collect Star Fragments: Master each level by collecting hard-to-reach star fragments that unlock additional challenges.
[*] Enjoy Classic Gaming Vibes: With vibrant 16-bit style pixel art and an energetic chiptune soundtrack by Rafael Langoni.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gdYocjQ.png[/img]

And don’t forget – [u][b]NO JUMPING!
[/b][/u]

[h3]Wishlist Super Magbot today![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205170/Super_Magbot/

notes.title: Magnet Monday Bonanza!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37459635/d982384b6deb5f2ccf71a12704bb290eea8ad5fd.png[/img][h3]Hello! 👋[/h3]

The sun is shining, Magbot is beaming -- because this week I'm showing off TWO new magnets! TWO! Fantastic news for everyone involved, we're all happy to be here. 

Let's kick things off!

[h3]Swapping Colour Magnets[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ezdQuuA.gif[/img]

As the Tekians can only use one colour, the first Tekian engineers created these Magnets. This way, every Tekian could make use of any Magnet. Swapping Colour magnets switch to the opposite colour as soon as you shoot them. The colour swapping is basically instantaneous, so perhaps you can take advantage of it in some way! 

[h3]Who are the Tekians?[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mmmBgfx.gif[/img]

The Tekians are the inhabitants of MagTeK. They are all robots and each one of them can manipulate one magnetic polarity (either blue or red). They are intelligent, peaceful robots who enjoy socialising and being active. Visually, they are red or blue - depending on the polarity colour they can manage. 🧲

[h3]Gum Magnets[/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iTwFHce.gif[/img]

Only the most advanced explorers know about the existence of these bouncy Magnets. So get good! Shoot at them using the same colour to get propulsed off. Use the opposite colour to attract to them and bounce off in the reflected direction. Changing your shooting angle with superb precision will make you bounce further! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Uhymkdo.gif[/img]

[h3]Don't forget to wishlist Super Magbot and play the demo! We launch next week, June 22nd! [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205170/Super_Magbot/

notes.title: Magnet Monday - Cloud Magnets!
notes.content:
Hello, hello, hello! It's the beginning of another glorious week. So, let's kick things off with some more magnets!

This week, we're going to talk about.....

[h3]Cloud Magnets [/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/isWQ8pD.gif[/img]

Occasionally, when the temperatures are at scorching heights, the Magnetic dust from the air can merge into a Cloud Magnet! As this Magnet is made of dust, you can't collide against it. Use the same colour to get propulsed off - and use the opposite colour to get attracted through the cloud magnet. Try to shoot just after reaching the cloud to perform two jumps in a row! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XOcHWgg.gif[/img]

Sounds easy, right? Well, maybe for me - but I'm unsure whether you're up to the challenge..... I guess you'll have to prove me wrong.

Super Magbot has a playable demo on Steam and will release on June 22nd! Not long now, I hope you're ready!

notes.title: Magnet Monday | Fragile Magnets
notes.content:
[h2]Fragile Magnets[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xpsYkkR.png[/img]

Do not let these Magnets get in your way! Shoot at them using the opposite colour with your magnetic ray to get propelled and smash through them - use the same colour to propulse Magbot off. It's always fun to break things, but be aware that fragile magnets won't be merged back once they are broken!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4iIXH8r.gif[/img]

[h2]Have a try yourself! [/h2]

You can play the Super Magbot demo on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205170/Super_Magbot/
